lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਨਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bin satigur seve jam pur badhe maareean muhi kaalai uth jaahi ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without serving the True Guru, they are bound and beaten in the City of Death; they arise and depart with blackened faces. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਲਉ ਐਸੀ ਰੀਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaalau aisee reet jit mai piaaraa veesarai ||
lines.translation: Burn away those rituals which lead you to forget the Beloved Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੇਤੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਹੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saaee bhalee pareet jit saahib setee pat rahai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, sublime is that love, which preserves my honor with my Lord Master. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: har iko daataa seveeai har ik dhiaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Serve the One Lord, the Great Giver; meditate on the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: har iko daataa ma(n)geeai man chi(n)diaa paaeeai ||
lines.translation: Beg from the One Lord, the Great Giver, and you shall obtain your heart's desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਦੂਜੇ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਤਾ ਲਾਜ ਮਰਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: je dooje paasahu ma(n)geeai taa laaj maraaeeai ||
lines.translation: But if you beg from another, then you shall be shamed and destroyed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin seviaa tin phal paaiaa tis jan kee sabh bhukh gavaaeeai ||
lines.translation: One who serves the Lord obtains the fruits of his rewards; all of his hunger is satisfied.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tin vitahu vaariaa jin anadin hiradai har naam dhiaaeeai ||10||
lines.translation: Nanak is a sacrifice to those, who night and day, meditate within their hearts on the Name of the Lord. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੰਉ ਆਪਿ ਤੁਠਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਜਨ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat janaa ka(n)u aap tuthaa meraa piaaraa aape laian jan laai ||
lines.translation: He Himself is pleased with His humble devotees; my Beloved Lord attaches them to Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਦਿਤੀਅਨੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paatisaahee bhagat janaa kau diteean sir chhat sachaa har banaai ||
lines.translation: The Lord blesses His humble devotees with royalty; He fashions the true crown upon their heads.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sukheee niramale satigur kee kaar kamaai ||
lines.translation: They are always at peace, and immaculately pure; they perform service for the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੇ ਓਇ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਭਿੜਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: raaje oi na aakheeahi bhiR marahi phir joonee paahi ||
lines.translation: They are not said to be kings, who die in conflict, and then enter again the cycle of reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਕਂੀ ਵਢਂੀ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vin naavai naka(n)ee vadha(n)ee phirahi sobhaa mool na paahi ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without the Name of the Lord, they wander about with their noses cut off in disgrace; they get no respect at all. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਿਖਿਐ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun sikhiai saad na aaio jichar guramukh sabad na laagai ||
lines.translation: Hearing the teachings, he does not appreciate them, as long as he is not Gurmukh, attached to the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur seviai naam man vasai vichahu bhram bhau bhaagai ||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, the Naam comes to abide in the mind, and doubts and fears run away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਹੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jehaa satigur no jaanai teho hovai taa sach naam liv laagai ||
lines.translation: As he knows the True Guru, so he is transformed, and then, he lovingly focuses his consciousness on the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਆਗੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee har dar sohan aagai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, greatness is obtained; he shall be resplendent in the Court of the Lord hereafter. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਜਣ ਆਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurasikhaa(n) man har preet hai gur poojan aavahi ||
lines.translation: The minds of the Gursikhs are filled with the love of the Lord; they come and worship the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਣੰਜਹਿ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam vana(n)jahi ra(n)g siu laahaa har naam lai jaavahi ||
lines.translation: They trade lovingly in the Lord's Name, and depart after earning the profit of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਭਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurasikhaa ke mukh ujale har daragah bhaavahi ||
lines.translation: The faces of the Gursikhs are radiant; in the Court of the Lord, they are approved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਂਝ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur satigur bohal har naam kaa vadabhaagee sikh gun saa(n)jh karaavahi ||
lines.translation: The Guru, the True Guru, is the treasure of the Lord's Name; how very fortunate are the Sikhs who share in this treasure of virtue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੰਉ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜੋ ਬਹਦਿਆ ਉਠਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: tinaa gurasikhaa ka(n)u hau vaariaa jo bahadiaa uthadiaa har naam dhiaavahi ||11||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to those Gursikhs who, sitting and standing, meditate on the Lord's Name. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam nidhaan hai guramukh paaiaa jaai ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the treasure, which the Gurmukhs obtain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਦੀ ਵਥੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਅੰਧੇ ਭਉਕਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh ghar hodee vath na jaananee a(n)dhe bhauk mue bilalaai ||1||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are blind; they do not realize that it is within their own home. They die barking and crying. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਨਿਰਮਲੀ ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ka(n)chan kaaiaa niramalee jo sach naam sach laagee ||
lines.translation: That body is golden and immaculate, which is attached to the True Name of the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: niramal jot nira(n)jan paaiaa guramukh bhram bhau bhaagee ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh obtains the Pure Light of the Luminous Lord, and his doubts and fears run away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh sadaa sukh paavahi anadin har bairaagee ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs find lasting peace; night and day, they remain detached, while in the Love of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: se gurasikh dhan dha(n)n hai jinee gur upades suniaa har ka(n)nee ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed are those Gursikhs, who, with their ears, listen to the Guru's Teachings about the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਹੰਉਮੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਭੰਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur satigur naam driRaaiaa tin ha(n)umai dubidhaa bha(n)nee ||
lines.translation: The Guru, the True Guru, implants the Naam within them, and their egotism and duality are silenced.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਡਿਠਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੰਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin har naavai ko mitr naahee veechaar dithaa har ja(n)nee ||
lines.translation: There is no friend, other than the Name of the Lord; the Lord's humble servants reflect upon this and see.
